name: What is the typical process for a custom home addition with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a custom home addition with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process for a custom home addition begins with an initial consultation to understand your needs and vision. We then move through detailed design planning, including CAD-supported layouts, followed by comprehensive permit coordination. Our team manages all construction, structural integration, interior finishes, and exterior tie-in work, ensuring a single point of coordination from concept to completion. This managed process ensures your addition harmonizes with your existing home and lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group's process involves consultation, design planning, permit coordination, construction, and final walkthrough, all managed under one team.
